A '''red-skinned being''' worked as an associate of an [[Unidentified elite assassin|elite assassin]] assigned to kill [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].

==Biography==
During the early days of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a red-skinned, draconian associate of a [[Unidentified elite assassin|reclusive assassin]] acted as the assassin's [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]]. When he was met with a squad of 18 [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and their employer, a [[Unidentified wealthy industrialist|wealthy industrialist]], who wished to hire his boss for a hit on the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Vader to avenge his [[Unidentified wealthy industrialist's son|son]], he attempted to deny them access to his boss. While the associate was speaking with them, the assassin also made sure to silently kill off the hired guns before confronting the industrialist.<ref name="NA1">[[Darth Vader and the Ninth Assassin 1|''Darth Vader and the Ninth Assassin'' 1]]</ref>

Sometime later, the draconian associate encountered Vader (who had disposed of his boss earlier) and was presumably murdered by him.<ref name="NA5">[[Darth Vader and the Ninth Assassin 5|''Darth Vader and the Ninth Assassin'' 5]]</ref>
